# realuptime_check (Resource)

An **http** monitor (`POST /checks`). RealUptime probes the URL from each selected region on the interval and reports per-region truth. `name`, `url`, `interval_seconds`, `regions` and the response assertions are all updated in place (`PATCH /checks/{id}` and `PATCH /checks/{id}/assertions`, REA-226) -- changing any of them updates the existing check rather than replacing it, so its id and history are kept. Other monitor types (tcp, dns, smtp, heartbeat, multistep) are created from the dashboard and can be imported but not created here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An http monitor probed from two regions every 60 seconds, failing unless
# the response is a 2xx whose body contains "ok".
resource "realuptime_check" "api" {
  name             = "Public API"
  url              = "https://api.example.com/health"
  interval_seconds = 60
  regions          = ["iad", "fra"]

  assertion_status_min = 200
  assertion_status_max = 299
  assertion_body_op    = "contains"
  assertion_body_value = "ok"
}

# Minimal: every live region, the account's default interval, no assertions.
resource "realuptime_check" "www" {
  name = "Website"
  url  = "https://www.example.com/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docsgen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1-200 characters. Updated in place (`PATCH /checks/{id}`, REA-226).
- `url` (String) Public http(s) URL to probe. Private and internal addresses are refused (RU-3002). Updated in place (`PATCH /checks/{id}`, REA-226); each new value is re-checked against the same SSRF guard `POST /checks` uses.

### Optional

- `assertion_body_case_sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the body match is case-sensitive. Defaults to `true` when a body assertion is set; null otherwise.
- `assertion_body_op` (String) Body assertion: `contains` or `not_contains`. Set together with `assertion_body_value`; the value is matched as a literal substring, never a regex.
- `assertion_body_value` (String) Text the response body must (or must not) contain, 1-200 characters.
- `assertion_header_name` (String) Header assertion: the response header to inspect. Set together with `assertion_header_op` and `assertion_header_value`.
- `assertion_header_op` (String) `equals` or `contains`.
- `assertion_header_value` (String) Expected header value (or substring).
- `assertion_json_op` (String) `equals`, `contains`, or `exists`. `exists` takes no value.
- `assertion_json_path` (String) JSON assertion: a dotted path into the response body (e.g. `data.status`). Set together with `assertion_json_op`.
- `assertion_json_value` (String) Expected value at the path (omit for `exists`).
- `assertion_status_max` (Number) Highest acceptable HTTP status (100-599).
- `assertion_status_min` (Number) Status assertion: lowest acceptable HTTP status (100-599). Set together with `assertion_status_max`, min <= max.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between probes from each region. Must be at or above your plan's floor (refused with RU-3006 otherwise). Omitted, the account default applies. Updated in place (`PATCH /checks/{id}`, REA-226).
- `regions` (Set of String) Which live regions probe this check: any non-empty subset of `iad`, `sjc`, `fra`, `nrt`, each at most once. Omitted, every live region probes it. Updated in place.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The owning account's id.
- `id` (String) Check id (UUID).
- `type` (String) Monitor type. Always `http` for a check created by this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by check id (any monitor type; only http checks can be created here).
terraform import realuptime_check.api 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
